metadata.jobTitle: Actual Infrastructure Inventory & Staging Feasibility Audit

stagingRailwayService.verificationMethod: railway status / whoami check via CLI
stagingRailwayService.result: Unauthorized / No linked staging project found

stagingSupabaseProject.result: No staging project identifier or API keys provisioned in environment

step1_actualInfrastructureInventory.determination: Staging cloud infrastructure (Railway service and Supabase project) and custom DNS records have NOT been provisioned by the cloud account owner. Provisioning live paid/cloud infrastructure requires human administrative credentials.

requiredActions: Provision dedicated staging project in Supabase dashboard (free/pro tier)
Provision dedicated staging service in Railway dashboard or deploy via Railway CLI
Configure DNS CNAME records for staging-api.kshetra.in or document provider-native URL (e.g., kshetra-api-staging-xxxx.up.railway.app)
